title: What Is Diastasis Recti Surgery?
description: What diastasis recti surgery (diastasis repair) is, what it is for and when it is recommended. Care in Lima with price alternatives.
tldr: It corrects the separation of the abdominal rectus muscles (common after pregnancy) that causes bulging and discomfort. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
It corrects the separation of the abdominal rectus muscles (common after pregnancy) that causes bulging and discomfort.

How is it done?

Plication of the aponeurosis, open or laparoscopic/endoscopic, sometimes with repair of an associated hernia.

When is it recommended?

Symptomatic diastasis that does not improve with exercise, with or without an associated hernia. The surgeon decides.
